title: PokoPlan
tagline: Planning Poker App which can be used in video/audio calls.
description: Agile meetings are so important in software industry. People plan and execute things so that right decisions are made. Planning Poker comes here where use make it to plan our progress with active participation. Not only that this app can be used for fun as well. Playing in a video call with a friend who lives so far etc.
